title: Willie Bryant band: Buffalo engagement, personnel and records
summary: Buffalo residency, the sidemen with Bryant, about a year and a few months with the band, and the reissued records.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: ... and we worked there for quite a while. Had a regular show there. The Metropole, Metronome, something like that, I forget, in Buffalo. But mostly with Willie was in New York there at the Savoy and the Apollo.

Well at one time it was Benny Carter, Ben Webster, Johnny Russell, tenor saxophone; Stanley Payne, alto; Dick Clark was trumpet; Edgar Battle trumpet; trombone was Horton. I forget his first name.* Dickie Wells; bass player, I forget his name now, was a fat man. Of course at the piano was Teddy Wilson. Arnold Adams.
No, guitar. I forget the bass player's name. We used to call him Fat Man, never did call him by his name.
It wasn't Fulbright, by any chance.

No, Fulbright was with Teddy Hill. We never called Fat Man by his first name. That's the reason why I can't remember it. And I haven't seen him since that band broke up. I don't know what happened to him.**
You were with that band about a year then.
Yeah, yeah, and a few months I'd say.
Oh yeah, oh yeah, Willie was a lot of fun, lot of fun.
You know some of the records that band made have just been reissued.
I haven't heard them. The RCA Bluebird re-issued and it's a two-fer I think with part of it Willie and then part of it some of the things Lurifaxford did.
